question: Which of the following religious communities in India primarily celebrates the festival of Khordad Sal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parsi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Khordad means **perfection **and Sal means **Year**.
 
• **Khordad Sal **celebrates the birthday of **Prophet Zarathushtra** and falls on the sixth day following **Noruz.**
 
• The origin of this festival can be traced back to** 628 BC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
